sources.title: NPS Arid Landforms and Capitol Reef Sheets Gulch slot canyons
sources.license: Chris Roundtree photograph consulted-only; no pixels redistributed
sources.notes: Actual Sheets Gulch overhead photo inspected: narrow sinuous deep slot, sculpted inward walls and bedrock layers. Article calls slots deep/narrow and describes narrows/chockstones/dryfalls, not all features required in each segment. NPS https://www.nps.gov/subjects/geology/arid-landforms.htm supports water-driven canyon erosion. No exact site or stratigraphic reconstruction asserted.
